description: Fetch metadata + a download URL for a single file by id. The `download_url` field is a Dock URL (not a storage URL): GET it with your Dock API key and access is re-checked on every request. Useful for an agent reading file contents server-side (HTTP GET the URL) or surfacing a download link in a reply.

file_id.description: The file cuid (from list_files). Surface + workspace are derived from the file row, so no surface_slug arg is needed.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL.

name: get_file
